title: Creamy Irish Risotto with Mushrooms
description: A rich and creamy risotto dish made with Irish cream and topped with sautéed mushrooms.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the risotto and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the creamy sauce and Irish cream, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring constantly, until the risotto is creamy and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the Parmesan cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
